description: Turn any https product/store URL into a ShopAt-tracked Digidip or Amazon outbound link. Prefer a published deal go_url when ShopAt already lists that merchant URL; otherwise returns a Digidip/Amazon-wrapped URL. Never exposes third-party affiliate tags. Returns url, optional go_url, network, merchant_guess and disclosure.

url.description: Direct https:// product or store page URL.

name: wrap_link
title: Wrap a product URL
